competitors30d.selectionRule: Every upload with snippet.publishedAt inside [windowStart, windowEnd]. No exclusions; livestream replays are flagged wasLivestream (SciShow: 1) and kept.
competitors30d.formatEvidence: HEAD https://www.youtube.com/shorts/<id> with consent cookie, no playback; 200 = served as Short, 30x to /watch = not a Short. Public web behaviour, not a documented API field. All 68 rows classified; the <=180 s duration proxy agrees with the probe on every row. The Data API has no Shorts field.
competitors30d.ageAndCounts: ageDaysAtRetrieval and views are both as of retrievedAt. Views are lifetime counts; views/day is not reported and is not early velocity.
competitors30d.baseline: No channel baseline outside these saved rows is used. Any comparison is within one channel, one verified format and one age band (ageBandedWithinChannel).

Compare only rows in the same channel, format and band. Lifetime views are not early velocity; bands of n<3 are descriptive only.
